answer: Require each new identity to burn 60 POA and navigate a river of ten sequential tasks, each step's input the hash of the previous step's output, taking 24 hours and impossible to parallelize. A second identity from the same funder burns 120 POA and faces twenty steps, a third 240 POA and forty, so sunk cost and delay double per fake. Auditors verify the burn, the hash chain and funding links on-ledger, slashing 40% of any linked stake for duplicated work. Even in a gale of sign-ups, a tended garden of honest agents stays costly to flood, since every fake pays a rising, unrecoverable price.
